title: The Iron Phoenix - Natty Dread Christmas / Part 2

lines.l: We have been dreaming over the years, Chihuahua, of a very white Christmas, ooh yay, a very white Christmas, now is the time that we should realize, what we need is a nutty dread Christmas.
Ooyay, red, gold and green, chihuahua, chihuahua, chihuahua, chihuahua
We have a look with Santa Claus and tell him, pack his gifts and go
Chihuahua, we need a dread wrapped in red, gold and green
To ride his chariot over desire
DJ, DJ, DJ, DJ and Christmas
She wise men from the east
To bring an idol for our feast in this ya' Christmas
Ooh yay, a nutty dream of Christmas
Don't make no sense to why
Why not plant a gully tree
And make it grow to the sky
Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Naughty J. Christmas.
